name: Malvasia di Casorzo d'Asti

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for sweet red and rosé wine from at least 90% Malvasia di Casorzo, with Freisa, Grignolino and Barbera allowed up to 10%. It is made still or lightly fizzy, as spumante and as passito. The zone covers Casorzo, Grana and Grazzano Badoglio in Asti province and Altavilla Monferrato, Olivola, Ottiglio and Vignale Monferrato in Alessandria province.
